headline: Executive order names the World Organisation for Animal Health as an international group eligible for certain legal privileges and immunities in the US.
what_it_does: This order designates the World Organisation for Animal Health as a public international organization under US law. That status lets the organization receive certain privileges, exemptions, and immunities, such as some protections from lawsuits or taxes, that the US gives to recognized international bodies. No summary was provided, so the exact privileges granted are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: The World Organisation for Animal Health and its staff
who_it_affects.how: The organization may receive legal protections and exemptions in the US that are given to recognized international organizations.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 12, 2017; exact effective date not stated in the title.
